names: Garden Bar Grill & Smokehouse By Cue Point

quotes.Garden Bar Grill & Smokehouse By Cue Poi: Gather all your friends for a chaotic Afghan-Texan BBQ brisket feast in Cue Point's Notting Hill garden.\n
quotes.The Macbeth: The Macbeth is a Hoxton pub for people who love pubs, but would also quite like to pretend they're in sunny Portugal.\n
quotes.The Waterman's Arms: The Waterman's Arms is a riverside pub in Barnes that serves great modern European food and even better Sunday roasts.
quotes.Café François: Café François is a useful, all-day Borough Yards spot, that serves reliably tasty French food and is likely to solve a good chunk of your dining dilemmas.
quotes.The Devonshire: The Devonshire is a handsome Soho pub with flawless British dishes and a crowded bar that feels very Dickens-meets-Guy Ritchie.
quotes.Inis: Inis is an all-day, British-Irish spot with a pretty location in Hackney Wick, and big Irish breakfasts that will cure your white pudding ick.
quotes.The George: The George is a classy Fitzrovia pub that combines a boozy downstairs with a decadent dining room upstairs, both of which serve a serious Sunday roast.
quotes.The Tamil Crown: The Tamil Crown in Angel is an excellent pub and Indian restaurant, made for moody date nights.
quotes.Guanabana: Guanabana is a cool spot in Camden serving Caribbean-inspired dishes and one of the best halal Sunday roasts in London.
quotes.The Selkirk: The Selkirk, a rustic Tooting pub, is ideal for midweek pints and serves a truly epic Sunday roast.
quotes.The Baring: The Baring is a polished pub-cum-restaurant in Islington, that makes excellent food in a room that's more sit-down than somewhere you can have a few pints.
quotes.The Clarence Tavern: The Clarence Tavern is a gastropub in Stoke Newington that's just as good for a slap-up meal as it is for a few pints and a nibble.
quotes.The Camberwell Arms: The Camberwell Arms is a traditional south London pub, serving great British cuisine during the week and incredible roasts on a Sunday.
quotes.Marksman: Marksman is a pub/restaurant with excellent, elevated British food in Shoreditch. It's good anytime, but don't miss the Sunday roast.
quotes.Hawksmoor Borough: The Borough branch of the upmarket Hawksmoor steak palaces is every bit as accomplished as its siblings.
quotes.The Drapers Arms: The Drapers Arms is a residential pub in Islington with a bar downstairs, a dining room upstairs, and a garden you should take advantage of.
quotes.The Bull & Last: The Bull & Last is a Highgate pub made for Sunday lunches with a gaggle of mates, dogs, and more.

sources._note: New source, 21 Sep 2026. Run by Pub & Bar magazine (H2O Publishing), judged and dated, with a county winner, a regional winner and a national Pub & Bar of the Year each year, plus the Industry's Choice Award voted by a panel of 400 industry judges and published as a ranked top ten. Same caveat as the Estrella Damm ranking: it judges the PUB, not the roast. TRAP 12 - UK-WIDE: the 2026 national winner is The Gunton Arms in Norwich and eleven of the thirteen regional winners are outside London, so only the London region, the two London county winners and the London entries in the Industry's Choice ten are counted. Two of those London names are left out on purpose - Somers Town Coffee House (#2 Industry's Choice) and The Star by Liverpool Street (City of London county winner 2026) - because no operator page could be found for either and neither can be confirmed to serve a Sunday roast, so counting them here would be a roast citation for something that may not be one.
